title: ods Release Index
description: The release index lists one dataset family's source releases and the datasets built from each. Its names are the Data Package vocabulary the Parquet metadata and the datapackage.json view use: a source's version, hash and bytes, a dataset's name and version. Rules JSON Schema cannot express — that source versions are unique and ordered newest first, that each dataset version starts with its release's source version and dataset versions within a release are unique and ordered oldest first, and that merge operations refuse contradicted digests, hashes, or sizes — are enforced by ods itself as the authority.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema describing this release index format.

name.description: The dataset family this index lists, e.g. ods-data: the same name as the Parquet files' embedded datapackage object, the datapackage.json view, and the OCI repository.

source.description: The source family every release in this index comes from, constant across releases: its title and landing page as the view's sources[0] has them, and the publisher's signing keys when it signs.

title.description: The source's title, e.g. NHS Organisation Data Service XML Data.

path.description: The source's landing page: where to find its releases. Not a hash-stable URL.

signing_key_fingerprints.description: Upper-case 40-character hexadecimal SHA-1 fingerprints of the PGP keys the source publisher signs its releases with, ordered oldest first. A signature from any key in the set is accepted. A source that signs nothing omits it.
signing_key_fingerprints.$comment: NHS England publishes key files with dates and no expiry dates; for TRUD the set lists keys known to have been used to sign TRUD releases. Per-release attestations record the specific key that signed each archive.

mirrors.description: Ordered list of OCI registry mirror base URLs where release blobs and manifests can be fetched. Comes from configured upstream distribution mirrors (e.g. ods.fyi, ghcr.io); can be replaced when a fetched index provides a non-empty list of mirrors.

url.description: Base URL of the mirror registry.

releases.description: The source's releases and the datasets built from each, ordered newest source version first. Append-only: a release is never removed or reordered.

source.description: What the source published for this release, in the source's own word: the same facts, with the same names, as the Parquet files' embedded sources[0].

version.description: The source release's version: for TRUD, its release date, YYYY-MM-DD. Identifies the release row; immutable once recorded.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the source archive as published, 'sha256:' followed by 64 lower-case hex characters, the form every hash in the Data Package vocabulary uses. Immutable once recorded. Merge refuses contradiction.
hash.$comment: The archive's filename is not stored because it is arbitrary and mutable; archives are identified strictly by hash. The SHA-1 NHS signs in its release checksum file is also not stored: SHA-256 is our primary integrity guarantee.

bytes.description: Size in bytes of the source archive, greater than zero. Immutable once recorded. Merge refuses contradiction.

issues.description: Optional IDs of known errors in this source release, each described, with how ods resolves it, at docs/source-issues/<id>.md in the ods repository. IDs only, never URLs. May appear on a row later; never removed.

datasets.description: The datasets built from this source release, ordered oldest dataset version first. May be empty. Append-only: a dataset is never removed.

version.description: The dataset's version, <source version>_<dataset version>, e.g. 2026-09-25_0.1.0: the version the Parquet files' embedded object, the view, the manifest's org.opencontainers.image.version and the OCI tag all give. The part after the _ is the dataset version (SemVer), which says which schema the files have. Identifies the dataset row; immutable once recorded.

manifest_digest.description: Content-addressed OCI manifest digest formatted as 'sha256:' followed by 64 lower-case hex characters. Computed from the dataset manifest generated and published by ods make release; immutable digest that never changes once recorded. Merge refuses contradiction.

bytes.description: Sum of the layer sizes in this dataset's OCI manifest, in bytes — what `ods pull` downloads and installs. Measured from the published manifest at build time; immutable size that never changes once recorded. Merge refuses contradiction.

tool_version.description: Semantic version string (SemVer) of the ods tool that built this dataset: the tag without its 'v'. Written by ods make release from its own build; immutable once recorded. Merge refuses contradiction. The convenient, git-reviewed pointer to the build; the CI attestation for the same manifest digest is the signed proof.

tool_git_sha.description: Lower-case 40-character hexadecimal Git commit SHA of the ods tool that built this dataset: the commit its tag v<tool_version> points at. Written by ods make release from its own build; immutable once recorded. Merge refuses contradiction.

doi.description: Optional Digital Object Identifier (DOI) assigned to this dataset on Zenodo. Assigned after archival publishing; optional field that may appear later and never contradicts once set.

withdrawn.description: Optional advisory explanation if this dataset was withdrawn due to corruption or data defect. Set by maintainers if a defect is identified; optional field that may appear later and never contradicts.
